scripts.lint: eslint apps packages tools/import-hsb tools/fault-fixtures/*.ts tools/bench/*.ts vitest.config.mts playwright.config.ts
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@water/shared && npm run build --workspace=@water/db && npm run build --workspace=@water/server && npm run build --workspace=@water/web && npm run build --workspace=@water/import-hsb
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run db:check && POSTGRES_DB=water_metering_bench npm run billing:seed && npm test && npm run bench:check && npm run build && npm run test:e2e
scripts.hsb:import: npm run build --workspace=@water/shared && node --import tsx tools/import-hsb/src/cli.ts
scripts.bench:check: npm run build --workspace=@water/shared && node --import tsx tools/bench/mode-check.ts
scripts.start:api: npm run build --workspace=@water/shared && npm run build --workspace=@water/server && node apps/server/dist/index.js
